title: 72 Needlerush Drive Vacation Rental
meta_description: 72 Needlerush Drive is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum allotted wristband qty is 8)- 6 Passenger Street Legal Golf Cart Included- 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Parking for 2 Vehicles (Garage Access Not Available)- Large Screened Porches- Outdoor Patio with Fire Pit- Propane Gas Grill- Exterior Shower- Located in the Heart of WaterColor's Lake District- Steps to Frog Pool- 2 Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor- 4 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club via Western Lake Bridge- 7 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Discover 72 Needlerush Drive, a stunning four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom home nestled in WaterColor’s Lake District, just steps from the Frog Pool. With easy access to the beach and beach club via the Western Lake bridge, this home is perfect for your getaway. Inside, an open living, dining, and kitchen area invites family fun and gatherings. The upper and lower screened porches offer serene views of Oak Grove Park and the state forest. The first floor features a master bedroom with a king bed and a luxurious bathroom, plus a charming half bath near the spacious kitchen and living area, which boasts soothing decor, a flat-screen TV, and a cozy fireplace. Upstairs, the second master offers another king bed, a private bath with a soaking tub, and access to the upper porch—ideal for morning coffee. A queen bedroom and a third bedroom with a daybed and office space complete the second floor, each with their own bathrooms. With four bikes included, you can easily explore WaterColor's scenic paths, 30A beaches, and community pools. Experience an unforgettable vacation—book your stay at 72 Needlerush Drive today!
